meta.name: test-assumptions
meta.description: Challenge a proposed solution by identifying and testing consequential assumptions. Use when the brief feels too certain or discovery reveals contradictions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手前把方案里最关键的假设挑出来逐一验证,避免想当然
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果方案看着很确定,你却隐约觉得哪里不太对
copy.tagline_en: Surface and test the key assumptions behind a plan before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a plan looks certain but something still feels off

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先找出你方案里影响最大的几个假设,再逐条检验,而不是直接照着方案往下做。产出的是假设清单和检验结果。
howto.when: 当需求说明显得过于笃定,或调研中出现互相矛盾的信息时触发;被 @fde 调用时,沿用其已有的范围与上下文。

say.text: 挑战一下这个方案,列出最关键的假设并逐条测试
这份调研有两处说法矛盾,帮我查清哪边站得住
沿用当前范围,不用重新调研,直接检验这些假设
say.note: 复用已有上下文,不重启流程

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude finds the most consequential assumptions in your proposed solution and tests each one instead of just executing the plan. You get the assumption list plus test results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the brief feels too certain or discovery turns up contradictions; when called by @fde it reuses that scope and context.

say_en.text: Challenge this solution: list its most consequential assumptions and test each one
say_en.note: Reads the method, then tests each

say_en.text: Two statements in this research contradict each other — find which one holds up
Reuse the current scope, skip new discovery, just test these assumptions
